testcase.name: lexical guard leaves standard number and structure validation to JsonReader
malformed nonstandard and trailing JSON is rejected
encode rejects invalid duplicate and oversized records without dropping them
syntax calendar and minute fields are strict
full store allows replacing an existing date and rejects a new date
conflicting date duplicates are discarded independently of array order
invalid entries do not erase well formed neighbors
numbers booleans nulls and wrong field names are not coerced to valid strings
saving same date replaces only this parish and date while deletion restores absence
decode caps complete input and array length
parish identity is bounded and cannot be whitespace or control characters
duplicate JSON fields never silently replace the selected start
personal start round trips with exact calendar date and local minute
uppercase or mixed case JSON literals reject the complete malformed payload
rejected identity timezone and DST saves preserve previous explicit start
storage exceptions are reported as failure instead of crashing
nonstandard apostrophe escape is rejected while standard escaped strings round trip
escaped JSON size is checked before writing and survives restart
wrong preference type recovers and unrelated settings stay intact
